prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1230; do not mention it.)
text: The patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain, restricted range of motion, and intermittent numbness radiating into the right upper arm. Initial examination revealed tenderness over the anterior glenohumeral joint, decreased active abduction and external rotation, and positive impingement signs. Imaging was obtained to rule out fracture and showed no acute bony abnormality, with findings consistent with a soft tissue strain and mild rotator cuff tendinopathy. Conservative management was initiated, consisting of a structured physical therapy program focusing on scapular stabilization, progressive range of motion, and rotator cuff strengthening, supplemented by ice, a short course of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory medication, and activity modification. The patient completed 22 visits over the treatment period. Pain scores and functional measures improved steadily, with near-full active range of motion restored by discharge. Residual mild discomfort with overhead lifting persists, and a home exercise program was provided. The patient was discharged to self-directed care with instructions to return if symptoms worsen or new neurological deficits develop.
